---
title: E. Reference data
---

Two files the **curation stack** (slidetap) reads to understand your site's data
model and local code vocabulary.

- **[model.json](reference-data-model.qmd)** — defines the attribute and observation model; copy the default to get started.
- **[mappers.xlsx](reference-data-mappers.qmd)** — translates your site's local short codes into BigPicture-standard coded attributes.
- **[Staining mapping](reference-data-staining.qmd)** — SNOMED CT codes, mapping modes, and naming conventions for staining attributes.

::: {.callout-note}
These two files are a **slidetap** concept, not a pipeline-only one — the same
`model.json` and `mappers.xlsx` are needed wherever the curation UI runs. The
placement steps on the pages below (`make setup-refdata`, `PIPELINE_REFDATA_DIR`)
are pipeline-specific; on the [Direct components](direct-components/index.qmd)
path you supply the same two files wherever your slidetap deployment expects them.
:::
